description: Data payload shape of 'snapshots.list' and 'snapshots.restore' (envelope.data). snapshots.list fills 'snapshots' (newest first) and nulls 'restore'; snapshots.restore nulls 'snapshots' and fills 'restore' (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 4.10).

snapshots.description: Snapshot entries for snapshots.list, or null for snapshots.restore.

restore.description: Restore outcome for snapshots.restore, or null for snapshots.list.

files_deleted.description: Files removed because the snapshot proved the run created them.

skipped.description: Link paths not recreated because a real directory/file sits there.

resnapshot_run_id.description: Snapshot of the pre-restore state (the restore stays undoable).

snapshot_entry.description: One snapshot directory with a readable manifest.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation time, or null for legacy manifests.

command.description: Command that created the snapshot, e.g. 'mcp.apply'.
